title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tape rotated: semis crushed, healthcare ripped. Treasury buyback news knocked yields down ~10-14bps, but hawkish FOMC minutes capped upside — semi rout signals a leadership transfer, not broad risk-off.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, below 20d MA of 16.3. Ranking: IWM +0.50%, DIA +0.26%, SPY +0.21%, QQQ -0.20%, SOXX -2.21%. Small > large by 0.29pp. GLD +3.84% led cross-asset. Neither SPY nor QQQ below 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.9 (near avg, price flat), QQQ vol_ratio 0.8 (below avg, price down = weak distribution). GLD 2.1x, SLV 1.4x on big up moves = accumulation in metals. IWM 0.8x with +0.50% = low-conviction small-cap bounce.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +3.51%, XLY Discretionary +1.92%, XLB Materials +1.43%, XLP Staples +1.12%, XLRE Real Estate +0.81%, XLC Comms +0.76%, XLU Utilities +0.00%, XLE Energy -0.16%, XLF Financials -0.62%, XLI Industrials -0.88%, XLK Technology -1.07%. Top: GDX +9.42%, IBB +6.58%. Bottom: SOXX -2.21%, KRE -2.41%. Money out of semiconductors and banks into healthcare and metals — biotech-led rotation, tech leadership broken. Label: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — IWM PCR 2.06 extreme protection, skew +3.4% fear. GLD PCR 1.34 with negative skew, GEX flip 404 vs spot near maxpain — dealer hedging amplifying gold rally. VIX 14.9 below 20d = complacency despite tech selloff.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +3.84% and silver +4.47% surging while dollar -0.92% — classic USD-down metals-up transmission. TLT +1.67% confirms rate relief driving today's bid.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 51.1 Neutral. Movers: MRK +12.60% on huge unusual put volume headline, AEM +11.12% 8-day streak, WPM +11.10% CEO transition. WPM vol 3.5x with price up = accumulation. Watch: SLV +4.47% (PCR 0.24 complacency vs gamma flip 59.5), KRE -2.41% (2.1x vol, distribution), IBB +6.58% (biotech breadth vs SOXX -2.21% divergence).
